content.text:
Submitted at the preferred level.

**What changed from the prior submission:** the "Customer convenience termination present" gate kept failing while that element was mapped as `already_met`, so I moved it into operative language rather than relying on evidence quotes. Three surgical edits to Section 3.4 now carry the preferred checklist:

1. **p0044** — "for convenience at the end of any calendar month" → "for convenience at any time" (removes the month-end effective-date restriction; grant, prerequisite carve-out and all other wording retained verbatim).
2. **p0045** — "at least one month's prior written notice" → "at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice" (satisfies the ≤30-day ceiling; shorter notice favours us).
3. **Insert after p0047** — IBM refunds prepaid charges pro rata for the period after the effective date of termination.

The fourth element (no Vendor convenience right in a committed term) remains already met by Section 3.3's breach-only IBM exit, quoted verbatim. I noted in the rationale that we would fall back to capping the Section 3.4(b) early termination charges at three months' charges if IBM resists the preferred package.
